description: This file defines a mock class MediaKeysClientMock for testing purposes, which implements the IMediaKeysClient interface. It includes mock methods for license request handling, license renewal, and key status changes, and is part of the firebolt::rialto namespace.

classes.name: MediaKeysClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysClient interface for testing media key interactions.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Mock method to simulate handling of license requests with session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Mock method to simulate license renewal handling with session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Mock method to simulate key status change notifications with session ID and key statuses.
